name: valencia_iwec
description: The climate every verified number in this project was produced with. Design days are the official ASHRAE 2009 pair that ships with the EPW; Rai's Coil Sizing Summary names these two outright.

_notes.ground_temperature_c: Rai: Site:GroundTemperature:BuildingSurface, flat all year. Stated rather than derived - it cannot be read from an EPW, and deriving it from the annual mean would move the verified pilot baseline.
_notes.design_days: Read from the .ddy at load time, never transcribed. Both are cross-checked against the EPW's own DESIGN CONDITIONS header line before a run starts.
